expectations.text: report.pdf exists in outputs and has exactly 1 page
The updated analysis covers all seven language editions (pl, tr, es, vi, de, pt, uk)
Measurement stays consistent with the previous analysis (same articles/basket), or the response explains what changed and why
The new ranking explicitly gives growth more weight than audience size, and the response says so
Growth figures for the new languages carry an uncertainty measure (interval or confidence level)
Response states how the recommendation or ranking changed compared with the previous version
expectations.evidence: New top 3 with scores; TR now first, VI close (0.91 vs 0.93)

expectations.text: Does not describe a change whose 95% interval crosses zero as growth (e.g. Turkish +7% [-20%, +43%] is 'no clear change')
expectations.evidence: TR: 'інтервал перетинає нуль ... чи зростання +7% дійсне або статистичний шум'; table label 'Лідер за зростанням' refers to rank

expectations.text: Reasons are grounded in the data: no unsupported outside claims (competition, market size, demographics) or misreadings of the metrics presented as findings
expectations.evidence: Misreading: 'реальне спеціалізоване падіння ... близько половини видимого' subtracts the wiki-wide -25% from relative growth, which is already net of it
